messages:
Alex (CS): Quick heads-up — AcmePay onboarding showing odd tail latency and token spikes on document ingestion flows (OCR-heavy invoices). Renewal touch coming in 3 weeks; want to propose a proactive perf play: int8 quant on their primary model + a rule-based routing fallback to a compact model for long docs. Thoughts?
Priya (SE): Can you paste the numbers? p50/p95/p99 and token cost diff?
Alex (CS): p50=120ms, p95=820ms, p99=1.9s on generate. Token cost up ~37% vs baseline since they started sending scanned PDFs. Most requests hit >1024 tokens after OCR tokens are included.
Alex (CS): My quick idea: apply int8 quant profile (safe-latency) + add routing policy so >1200 combined tokens => route to compact model with tuned prompt. Start with a 10% canary.
Jorge (Eng): Sounds reasonable. Concern is quality regressions on extraction accuracy. We should run a small eval set from their prod prompts and compare EM/F1 before wide rollout.
Priya (SE): Totally. Suggest flow: 1) run eval with 200 real samples, 2) enable canary 10% for 48h, 3) monitor quality deltas + latency/cost, 4) escalate to 50%/100% if stable.
Alex (CS): I can grab 200 samples (anonymized) from their onboarding dataset. Also renewal note: CS flagged as 'watch' because latency spikes correlate with slow user flows — want to show cost savings to improve renewal sentiment.
Jorge (Eng): For routing, I can add a policy like:
```json
{"rule": "if request.tokens.total > 1200", "route": "compact-x-small-v2", "fallback": "primary-int8"}
```
We'll add feature flags so we can flip off quickly.
Priya (SE): Can we also add an auto-fallback if compact model confidence drops below threshold? Eg check `response.confidence < 0.75` -> re-run on primary int8 and attach both outputs for manual review.
Jorge (Eng): Yup, we can implement a dual-call fallback with lightweight consensus. I'll stub it and run locally.
deploy-bot: canary deployment started for policy `acmepay-int8-routing` at 5912345722 :rocket:
Alex (CS): Drafting a short customer note to share once canary is healthy — will include expected latency/cost delta and a window for rollback. DMing legal for anonymized eval consent.
Priya (SE): Draft looks good, ping me to review before sending. Also add a short eval dashboard in Console (latency by route, extraction EM).
Jorge (Eng): I'll wire the metrics to per-route dashboards and add an alert for p99 > 1.5s or quality drop >5% EM.
Alex (CS): Assigning action items: Alex — collect 200 samples + customer note (by EOD), Priya — prepare eval harness + acceptance criteria (tomorrow AM), Jorge — implement routing + fallback canary (48h).
Priya (SE): ack.
Jorge (Eng): ack.
Alex (CS): Thanks team — goal is to reduce p99 below 1.2s and token costs by ~20% without hurting accuracy. Will update here after 24h of canary. :thumbsup:
